chunks.en: It tears away all this idea about your personal need. It tears away all the idea about your personal feelings. I have a relationship with God. That's what the psychologists would say. For Durkheim, society is the ultimate sense of feeling. How you feel depends on how society tells you to feel. Society that creates another duality, the duality of the sacred. So this superstructure that oversees you tells you how to think, tells you how to feel, tells you how to act.
chunks.zh: 它撕掉了所有关于你个人需求的观念。它撕掉了所有关于你个人感受的观念。我与上帝有关系。这就是心理学家会说的。对涂尔干来说，社会是终极的情感感知。你的感受取决于社会告诉你该如何感受。社会创造了另一种二元性，即神圣的二元性。所以这个监督你的上层建筑告诉你该如何思考，告诉你该如何感受，告诉你该如何行动。

chunks.en: What does it do to tell you how to feel, how to act? You use religion. In that sense, I mentioned this before in various parts of this lecture. Why do we have religion? We have religion because religion provides social control. And society is under some form of control by society. And how and what does society use to control you? It uses religion. But not just controlling you. It provides, and which we'll see in a short film, a short film.
chunks.zh: 告诉你该如何感受，该如何行动，这有什么作用？你用宗教。从这个意义上讲，我之前在本讲座的各个部分提到过这一点。我们为什么有宗教？我们有宗教是因为宗教提供社会控制。而社会以某种形式受到社会的控制。那么社会用什么方式和手段来控制你呢？它用宗教。但不仅仅是控制你。它还提供，如我们将在一部短片中看到的，一部短片。

chunks.en: In the film it provides the basis of cohesion, control. That seems like a magnetic element. But there's a positive element. It brings people together. It gives you purpose together. It allows you to literally communicate with each other. You share the common belief. That common belief makes you act in almost common ways. A Christian would tend to behave like this. Buddhists would tend to behave like this. Because those societies, those religions are to act on you as people.
chunks.zh: 在电影中，它提供了凝聚力和控制的基础。那看起来像是一个有吸引力的元素。但它也是一个积极的元素。它将人们聚集在一起。它给你们共同的目标。它允许你们真正彼此交流。你们分享共同的信念。那种共同的信念使你们几乎以相同的方式行动。基督徒往往会这样行为。佛教徒往往会这样行为。因为那些社会，那些宗教会以某种方式影响你们作为人去行动。

chunks.en: So religion has two people together. Mentally together. It's a mental process. But physically together. In the film you watch millions of people going to America. What is it doing? It's a ritual. Religion is belief and rituals. It's a ritual that pulls people together. So that you have a common sense of belonging. You have a common sense of belonging. You have a common sense of all of you having the same mind.
chunks.zh: 所以宗教是让两个人在一起。心灵上在一起。这是一个心理过程。但是身体上也在一起。在电影中，你看到数百万人前往美国。那在做什么呢？这是一个仪式。宗教是信仰和仪式。这是一种把人们聚集在一起的仪式。这样你就有一种共同的归属感。你有共同的归属感。你有所有人心意相通的共同感觉。

chunks.en: The ritual makes you believe that you belong to a community of believers. As I said, that time's idea was not popular for a long time. I wrote my master's thesis using the Khymen ideas. When I did my PhD, I gave up on that time. I did my thesis using De Deirian and Kitsin ideas. But today, the latest book that I read resuscitates that time's idea. Resuscitates the central idea about religion as society. Religion as community. So religion as belief, shared belief.
chunks.zh: 这个仪式让你相信自己属于一个信徒社区。正如我所说，那一时期的观点并不是很流行。我在写硕士论文时使用了Khymen的观点。当我攻读博士时，我放弃了那个时期的观点。我写博士论文时使用了De Deirian和Kitsin的观点。但今天，我读的最新书籍让那个时期的观点复活了。复活了关于宗教作为社会的核心观点。宗教作为社区。所以宗教作为信仰，共同的信仰。

chunks.en: Religion as community. Shared behavior. Every time you go to church on Sunday. Every time you go to pray in the mosque on Fridays. Every time, once a year, or not once a year. Once in your lifetime, you must go to Mecca. All those ideas is to reaffirm the collective. As I said, the study of religion is not the study of religion. It is the study of society. Because religion is society. I'll finish this part and then I will move to that. So religion ensures a sentiment.
chunks.zh: 宗教作为社区。共享行为。每次你在星期天去教堂。每次你在星期五去清真寺祈祷。每次，一年一次，或者不是一年一次。你一生中必须去一次麦加。所有这些想法都是为了重申集体。如我所说，宗教研究不是宗教本身的研究。它是对社会的研究。因为宗教就是社会。我先完成这一部分，然后我会转向那个。所以宗教确保了一种情感。

chunks.en: Same feeling, same sense of belonging to a group. Not belonging to a religion. As I emphasize this, belonging to a group. So the function of religion is to make you belong to a group. So God is society. And religion is not just about belief. Religion as you all know and you are studying in your project. Religion is about ritual. It's about a series of activities that you perform. Whether that's going to church on Sunday or going to mosque on Friday.
chunks.zh: 相同的感觉，相同的群体归属感。不是归属于某种宗教。当我强调这一点时，是归属于一个群体。所以宗教的功能就是让你归属于一个群体。所以上帝就是社会。而宗教不仅仅关乎信仰。宗教如你们所知，你们在项目中正在学习的。宗教关于仪式。它是一系列你执行的活动。不管是星期天去教堂还是星期五去清真寺。

chunks.en: Or praying five times a day. Those are all rituals. Right? And when you perform the ritual, what does it do? It brings together the sense of collective sentiment. And Islam is a fascinating religion in this sense. And I will discuss this when I look at Islam. Islam makes people feel that they all belong to Islam. Right? The central one is the collective people, Muslims, community of Muslims. In my view, Islam is the collective people of Muslims, community of Muslims.
chunks.zh: 或者每天祈祷五次。这些都是仪式，对吧？当你执行仪式时，它会做什么？它会汇聚集体情感。而从这个意义上说，伊斯兰教是一个非常有趣的宗教。当我研究伊斯兰教时，我会讨论这一点。伊斯兰教让人们感到他们都属于伊斯兰教，对吧？中心的是集体的人，穆斯林，穆斯林社区。在我看来，伊斯兰教就是穆斯林的集体，穆斯林的社区。

chunks.en: You hurt one Muslim, you hurt all Muslims. Which is why 9-11 happened. Right? So ritual sense.
chunks.zh: 你伤害一个穆斯林，你伤害所有穆斯林。这就是为什么发生9-11，对吗？所以是仪式感。
